newsitem.title: CANADA: CBRS reaffirms Newcourt Credit ratings.
newsitem.headline: CBRS reaffirms Newcourt Credit ratings.

text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service said that it had reaffirmed the A-1 (low) and A (low) ratings on the commercial paper and medium term notes of Newcourt Credit Group Inc following the announcement on Thursday that the company had reached an agreement to buy Commcorp Financial Services Inc.
CBRS also said the rating outlook on Newcourt remained positive.
Newcourt has agreed to buy all the outstanding common shares of Commcorp at a price of C$361 million (US$260.2 million) to be paid in cash and Newcourt common shares.
The proposed acquisition will be beneficial to Newcourt's long-term growth because it gives the company better access to some areas of the asset-based financing industry, CBRS said.

In a separate statement, CBRS said it had reaffirmed the A-1 (low) and A (low) ratings on Commcorp's commercial paper and medium term paper and upgraded Commcorp's rating outlook to positive from negative.
((Paul Simao, Reuters Toronto Bureau (416) 941-8104) or email: paul.simao@reuters.com)
